visualFindings.style: Consistent restrained Southern Song inspired architectural sprites with dark outlines and muted mineral colors.
visualFindings.palette: Intermediate RGB values remain throughout the generated images; these are not strictly nine-color indexed PNGs.
visualFindings.flatFill: Visible gentle tonal variation or mottling remains in some roofs, walls and ground surfaces; the no-gradient requirement is not fully met.
visualFindings.projection: A common isometric/dimetric camera was requested. Exact 2:1 geometry for all architectural lines and consistent per-sprite anchors have not been certified.
visualFindings.palace: Regenerated with extra transparent padding; original candidate preserved in drafts.
visualFindings.runtime: No game assets or code replaced. Sprite pivots, scale and runtime map placement were not calibrated.

preview.browserQA: Local server start and file-URL browser preview were blocked by policy. PNGs were inspected directly.
